Its placeholder-tab helper contains the exact developer-facing text 'By the way, I'm going to theme this whole side panel.', directly identifying the enclosing surface as the side panel.

The panel aggregates launcher-only Swing components (loadout panel, PvP tracker panel, GPU panel, item search/development panel) and exposes the tabbed pane/components back to Launcher code; it owns no gameplay/network protocol state.
